  [ PART  I-A 
1. 
(1) 
These rules may be called the Gujarat Panchayats Elections (Amendment) Rules, 2025. 
(2)  
They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2.  
In the Gujarat Panchayats Elections Rules, 1994 (hereinafter referred to as "the said rules"), in rule 12, in  
sub-rule (1), for the words and figures “A nomination paper in Form – 4”, the words and figures “A Nomination 
Paper in Form-4 for Taluka or District Panchayat Election and a Nomination Paper in Form – 4 (A) for Village 
Panchayat Election” shall be substituted. 
3.   
In the said rules, in rule 12, in sub-rule (2), in the third proviso, for the words “nine seconders”, the words “ten 
seconders” shall be substituted. 
4.  
In the said rules, in rule 15, in sub-rule (2), clause (b) shall be deleted.  
5.  
In the said rules, in rule 15, for sub-rule (7), the following sub-rule shall be substituted, namely:- 
“(7) For the purposes of this rule, the production of a certified copy of an entry made in the list of voters for the 
time being in force of any electoral division shall be conclusive evidence of the right of any voter named in that 
entry to contest the election or to subscribe to a nomination paper, as the case may be, unless it is proved that the 
candidate is disqualified, within the meaning of sub-section (2) of section 28 of the Act, to contest the 
elections.”.

NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 3rd July 2025 
Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993. 
No. KP/31 of 2025/PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2024/2151/Section-G: WHEREAS certain draft rules, were published as 
required by sub-section (5) of section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), -at pages 30-1 to 
30-16 in the Gujarat Government Gazette, Extraordinary, Part I-A, Central Section, dated the 12th March, 2025, under 
the Government Notification, Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department No.KP/68 of 2024/ 
PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2024/2151/Section-G, dated the 11th March, 2025, inviting objections and suggestions from all 
persons likely to be affected thereby before the expiry of thirty days from the date of publication of the said notification 
in the Official Gazette; 
AND WHEREAS, no objection or suggestion has been received by the Government in respect to the said draft 
notification; 
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 274 read with the 
sub-section (2) of section 15 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby 
makes the following rules further to amend the Gujarat Panchayats Election Rules, 1994, namely: -

64-2 
GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 04-07-2025 
  [ PART  I-A 
1. 
(1) 
These rules may be called the Gujarat Panchayats Elections (Amendment) Rules, 2025. 
(2)  
They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2.  
In the Gujarat Panchayats Elections Rules, 1994 (hereinafter referred to as "the said rules"), in rule 12, in  
sub-rule (1), for the words and figures “A nomination paper in Form – 4”, the words and figures “A Nomination 
Paper in Form-4 for Taluka or District Panchayat Election and a Nomination Paper in Form – 4 (A) for Village 
Panchayat Election” shall be substituted. 
3.   
In the said rules, in rule 12, in sub-rule (2), in the third proviso, for the words “nine seconders”, the words “ten 
seconders” shall be substituted. 
4.  
In the said rules, in rule 15, in sub-rule (2), clause (b) shall be deleted.  
5.  
In the said rules, in rule 15, for sub-rule (7), the following sub-rule shall be substituted, namely:- 
“(7) For the purposes of this rule, the production of a certified copy of an entry made in the list of voters for the
